answers.core: It is a change to a core resource.
answers.workaround: A similar effect can be achieved with a `StyleBoxFlat`, although it is a bit more inconvenient because you need to specify 4 corner radius and 2 content margins. With the proposed solution this would be reduced to 2 round caps and 1 thickness. There are also many elements that make more sense to think of as a line rather than a box, such as scrolls or separators. I also think it is nice to have a simple capsule shape, and rather than create a new one, the line would work fine.
